The following actions will give a chance to drop this pet:
• burning logs
• while having the Always Adze relic active
• using a Bonfire
• using a pitch can
• automatically by having the Superheat Form prayer active
• automatically by setting the Nature's sentinel outfit to Firemaking
• automatically by having Inferno adze activate
• burning curly roots
• burning bones using Cremation
• shovelling woodchips at Kiln (Clan Citadels)
• using a Herb burner
• during any step of making incense sticks
• auto-cremating Vyres with the Sunspear (melee), Sunspear (ranged) or Sunspear (magic)
• burning sharp shell shards from the 'Accidental' Fletching and Firemaking activity
• making dinosaur 'propellant' from the 'Accidental' Fletching and Firemaking activity
• Drying (or cutting and drying) scruffy zygomites from the 'Accidental' Fletching and Firemaking activity
• Using a pitch can to do enhanced line-style Firemaking 
• Using a pitch can to light fires in Char's training cave after completion of The Firemaker's Curse
The following actions will not give a chance to drop this pet:
• Using protean logs or unstable protean logs
• Playing a minigame that rewards experience in this skill

In a purely mathematical format, the chance f of receiving a pet on any particular action is
f = \frac{T \times S}{50,000,000}
Where:
• T is the amount of game ticks taken per action
• S is the virtual skill level. At 200 million experience, a flat bonus of 50 is applied to this value

Four rewards are received per chest. The chest is destroyed in the process. The unique items - Vorkath's spike and Invoke Lord of Bones incantation codex - are only rolled once per chest, in the first slot (consequently, slightly reducing the chance of common items for slot 1). Vorkath's claw (the Vorkath pet unlock item) and the Vorkath Necromancy weapon override token are added to the inventory directly upon completion of the fight and don't appear in the chest; Vorkath's scale is exclusive to the hard mode loot chest.
All items are awarded in noted form if not stackable.
▸ Rare drops
Rare drops are only rolled for once per chest, in the first slot. If not chosen, a common drop is given.
▸ Common drops
Rare drops are only rolled for once per chest, in the first slot. If not chosen, a common drop is given.
